about.heading: We are Clint and Marina - hi!
about.paragraph1: From our desire to creatively “wine-ify” all kinds of get-togethers, Dineysos was born: an innovative and unique provider of wine game concepts that will turn your event into the new hot topic in an unconventional way.
about.paragraph2: Our story begins like many others: After the third bottle of wine, we came to the realisation that a majority of events these days are very generic and the people have been waiting for something new. By combining a little pastime with the aforementioned wine a solution was quickly found: Dineysos!
about.paragraph3: Our concepts are educational, fun as well as flexibly adaptable and can be perfectly integrated into afterworks, employee events, dinner parties and any other kind of happening.
about.paragraph4: Everything is possible, from a simple “we bring our games and a suitcase full of wine” to a complete event with a suitable location and culinary delights.
about.marina: A hobby artist with a flair for Excel-Spreadsheets and a passion for all-things food.
about.clint: A brunch enthusiast, who never leaves the house without a hat and has an undeniable passion for wine - lots of wine.

trophy.title: Trophy
trophy.description: Several wine selection challenges await you, in which wine knowledge is rather modestly useful. Very engaging, more or less informative and with a glorious winner (or winning group, our concepts can also be played in teams) at the end.

classroom.title: Classroom
classroom.description: This game sends participants home wiser (at least wine-wise) than they already are. Wine knowledge is not required, but can be included in adjustment of the level of difficulty and information.

olympics.title: Olympics
olympics.description: What enhances any concept? Exactly, more wine. Olympics sets one series of wines in competition with a second series. Olympic Games with wines, so to speak. This concept is especially ideal for highlighting the nuances that go into wine making.

formats.title: Formats
formats.description1: Each Dineysos concept only comes to life through your event, the possibilities and combinations are endless. The rustic gastronomer around the corner interested in embarking on a wine & dine adventure will receive just as suitable a suggestion from us as the fancy tech company organising its 500 person employee event or the individual planning a dinner party at home.
